content.title: Character Action Type Cards | Identity-Locked Module Carousel
content.summary: Establish one clearly adult stylized character with at least three identity anchors and a compact original name mark. Rotate through at least four layout modules, limit each to one new short word or identity field, bind the word to one character action, verify identity once, then place the character inside the complete name-and-symbol mark and hold.

quick_start.input_format: stylized character with stable silhouette, palette, face marks and compact original name field + at least four genuinely different layout modules + one new short word and one character action per word-bearing module + identity preserved through flat, macro and shallow 3D formats + explicit repetition or verification + return to full character and original name field
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult bicycle courier with square glasses, a cyan helmet stripe and an orange jacket activates ROUTE, BRAKE, CLIMB and DELIVER through one matching action per card, appears in three numbered identity portraits, then lands inside the complete ARC MIRA location-pin mark.
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult stylized character with at least three identity anchors and one compact original name mark.
Use at least four distinct graphic modules but introduce no more than one new short word or identity field in each.
Preserve silhouette, face anchors, palette and mark geometry across flat cards and spatial modules.
Verify identity once, then place the character inside the complete original mark and hold.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish one clearly adult stylized character with at least three identity anchors and a compact original name mark. Rotate through at least four layout modules, limit each to one new short word or identity field, bind the word to one character action, verify identity once, then place the character inside the complete name-and-symbol mark and hold.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult stylized character through at least three stable identity anchors and a compact original name mark. Rotate through at least four visually distinct graphic modules; introduce no more than one new short word or identity field per module, and bind each word to one character action that crosses, strikes, occupies or reveals the typography. Preserve the same silhouette, face anchors, palette and mark geometry while layout depth and card structure change. Before the final lockup, include one explicit identity-verification module such as numbered portraits or a fixed character strip. End when one final action places the character inside the complete original name-and-symbol mark and all motion stops. The reusable mechanism is identity-locked module rotation, action-to-word binding, recurring graphic anchors and character-to-wordmark closure—not the source boxer, face, hair, clothes, words, logo, gym, poster layouts, palette, choreography, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult stylized character with at least three identity anchors and one compact original name mark.
invariants.purpose: Creates a stable subject before rapid layout changes begin.
invariants.ablation_failure: A generic character cannot survive a dense module carousel.

invariants.rule: Use at least four distinct graphic modules but introduce no more than one new short word or identity field in each.
invariants.purpose: Keeps every beat readable despite fast editing.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple new phrases per card create an illegible typography reel.

invariants.rule: Bind every module's word to one semantic character action that crosses, strikes, occupies or reveals it.
invariants.purpose: Makes typography and performance share one cause.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated character motion leaves the words decorative.

invariants.rule: Preserve silhouette, face anchors, palette and mark geometry across flat cards and spatial modules.
invariants.purpose: Maintains identity while the graphic language changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing several identity channels at once makes each module look like a new character.

invariants.rule: Verify identity once, then place the character inside the complete original mark and hold.
invariants.purpose: Converts the carousel into a finished title system.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on another transient card provides no terminal brand or identity proof.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source stylized boxer, face, hair, beard, body proportions, shorts, gloves and exact poses
the source TOBILLO KID name, NO REACH NO FEAR, KICK, FAST and all visible source wording
the source bell mark, kick graphic, triptych silhouettes, numbered fighter posters and exact logo layout
the source gym, ring, punching bag, paper cards, palette, camera path, actions and nine-cut timing
the source creator identity, WakeUpGFX marks, MiniMax H3 claim, watermark and branding
